name: Diqihao Lieche
source: 《Train No. 7》is a “sea turtle soup” type of puzzle game visual novel。The game describes “you” in this supposedly ordinary and comfortable journey, meeting a lone traveling girl。To pass the time, the girl begins to relate her story to “you”, but as her heart slowly begin to unfold, “you” actually discover something……
translation: 《七号列车》是一款“海龟汤”类型的益智游戏视觉小说。游戏描述了“你”在这个看似平凡而舒适的旅途中，遇见了一个孤独旅行的女孩。为了打发时间，女孩开始将自己的故事与“你”联系起来，但当她的内心慢慢展开时，“你”却发现了一些东西……
